name: HEY, EMILE
source:
"Hey, Emile. Welcome back"

Jane seems to have a few issues with her... AI girlfriend...? Well... That's what it seems on the surface. There might be something darker happening behind the curtains...

"Hey, Emile" is a Visual Novel submitted for the "TOXIC YURI VN DEV 2" VN Jam. This is a story with multiple endings, most of which are necessary to reach the "true" ending. Why? Well... You'll have to play it and find out...!

Change between playing as "Emile" or "Jane", both routes have events in common seen from different perspectives, but they also carry their own endings and explanations!

Re-visit one or the other's perspective until you get all the missing pieces of the puzzle... With each ending, the truth behind all of this unfolds more and more...

[From [url=https://lunavn.itch.io/hey-emile]itch.io[/url]]
